title: Door handle and latch usability
summary: Reviews in this topic focus mainly on awkward door-handle and latch design that makes opening, closing, or locating handles difficult, with a few examples also touching on touch-unlock behavior and hood-latch access.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe interior and exterior handles as awkward, unintuitive, uncomfortable, or hard to reach and use, including trouble with touch unlock and latch access.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention door-handle operation or placement, but the limited examples do not clearly show whether the comments are favorable or unfavorable.

signal_notes.interpretation: ICE examples in this topic are associated with more negative-or-mixed feedback than the comparison engine group, but the comparison sample is limited and this is only exploratory.
US examples account for most of the topic's feedback and are largely negative-or-mixed, but the non-US comparison is too small for a reliable contrast.

limitations: The topic includes a few potentially unrelated fragments, such as hood-latch access and one fragment whose quoted text does not clearly match handle-location issues.
Examples are sentiment-stratified and not a random sample, so they should not be treated as representative of all owners.
Undetermined evidence is sparse, so its meaning cannot be characterized beyond the limited examples shown.
